note: Source-checked official job drafts for Glance and Instawork. Review/approval required. Instawork text synchronized to live Greenhouse listing on 2026-10-17.

jobs.desc: Glance is hiring a UX Design Intern to support the team developing Glance TV, an AI-driven shopping experience on connected televisions. The intern works alongside experienced designers on shopping cards, brand stores, editorial layouts, ambient product experiences and agent interactions. The position involves design-system work, reviewing user flows and edge cases, design critique, exploration and delivery with engineering teams.
jobs.elig: Design student or recent graduate with a strong portfolio showing product-design thinking and execution. Curiosity about interaction design and user behaviour, systems thinking, reusable components, visual craft and iterative shipping. Interest in AI, ambient computing or TV/large-screen interaction is advantageous.
resp: Contribute UX and visual designs across shopping cards, brand stores, editorial layouts and TV agent interfaces.
Work through user flows, interface states and edge cases.
Maintain components, reusable patterns and documentation in the design system.
Participate in design critiques, reviews, explorations and iterations.
Support implementation handoff and collaborate with engineers to ship designs.

jobs.role: IT Intern – Gadget & Tech Support Operations
jobs.desc: Instawork is accepting applications for IT Intern – Gadget & Tech Support Operations in Bengaluru. The official listing describes an on-site Rig / Productivity operations internship, scheduled 9:00 AM–6:00 PM. The role involves receiving SD cards, uploading recorded field data to cloud systems, confirming successful transfer before formatting and returning cards, reviewing recorded videos to distinguish valid from invalid data, and maintaining accurate reconciliation and Google Sheets trackers. Candidates should expect repetitive, high-volume data-handling and quality-control tasks. The posting does not substantiate Apple ID administration or iPhone device provisioning as requirements.
jobs.elig: Required: basic computer knowledge and Google Sheets, handling SD cards and readers, computer-based file transfer, ability to follow technical checklists, high attention to accuracy, and patience for repetitive video validation. Prior data processing, video review, cloud uploads, quality checking or operational tracking is preferred, not mandatory. The official posting does not specify a minimum degree or graduation year.
resp: Receive and reconcile SD cards from the inventory team.
Upload recorded card data to cloud storage according to the defined process.
Verify upload completion before formatting cards.
Track successful, pending and failed transfers and escalate corrupt cards.
Format cards only after upload confirmation and return them to inventory the same day.
Review recorded videos and record valid or invalid data assessments.
Track the proportion of valid data at card and batch level.
Maintain accurate Google Sheets processing and reconciliation trackers.
Report outstanding batches, delays, quality concerns and data errors.
Apply prescribed operating procedures and avoid skipping or misrepresenting validation steps.
